reconcile.note: Adam Clarke explains that Eshtaol and Zorah were first assigned to Judah and later passed to Dan, accounting for their appearance in both tribal lists.

discrepancy.emptyNote: W. F. Albright catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: W. F. Albright, The Administrative Divisions of Israel and Judah, JPOS 5 (1925).
